_comment: cfos-mapper settings. Folders: where the brains (OME-Zarr, one per brain: <name>.ome.zarr) are, and where results go. Networks, reports, logs and atlases go next to the results folder unless given here (networks_folder, reports_folder, logs_folder, atlas.folder).
_channels: part of the channel names in the OME-Zarr files
_brightness_reference: every brain is scaled so that its median tissue brightness becomes these values (only for our own networks)
_full_brain: extra settings for finding candidates in a WHOLE brain: a local threshold on tiles of ~480 px (70 x soma diameter), the size of the test regions
_atlas: registration with brainreg. orientation: brainglobe letters for where image axes 0, 1, 2 start (s/i = superior/inferior, a/p = anterior/posterior, l/r = left/right)
